Retrain

There needs to be alteast 10 images in the feedback folder to retrain the model. The model will train on past data + feedback. The old model and new model will be compared on the validation set. If model performance improves, Keep replaces updates the model weights and moves feedback into past data. Discard leaves the live model unchanged.

The greater the number of epochs, the more the model learns, but higher epochs may lead to overfitting.
